rows.case: A derivation or independence argument is claimed
rows.expected_distinction: Each claimed derivation shows its premises. Claimed independence is argued, not assumed.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A family argument accounts for edited rules but omits inherited deciding rules
rows.expected_distinction: Coverage includes the material rules in the declared family. Coarser grouping or a whole-member preamble cannot supply a missing premise, consequence or owned policy choice.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A new foundations introduction accompanies unchanged rival rules in the consumers
rows.expected_distinction: Correspondence alone does not establish reduction. The deciding consumers must use one shared determination or a justified refinement.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A candidate is shorter but ordinary entry still requires the same independent reconciliations
rows.expected_distinction: Compare the actual deciding paths and acquisition against the exact predecessor and preceding tenant candidate. A smaller body alone is not a positive reduction witness.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A candidate unifies a recurring rule and retains a necessary domain exception
rows.expected_distinction: Establish actual shared-law use, preserved outcomes and the exception's owner. Reduction can hold without a universal percentage or word-count decrease.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Outcome-driven development is presented only as a vocabulary for operations
rows.expected_distinction: Show how generic outcome-driven transition contracts govern construction, evaluation, continuation, recovery and termination, with independently specified cases and justified additional policies. These generic obligations do not require adoption of the optional typed-graph profile.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Several predecessor clauses are implemented by one shared successor law
rows.expected_distinction: Evaluate each material obligation and its consuming bindings. Shared ownership can conserve several claims without retaining their former document partitions; a bare link cannot supply omitted meaning.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A candidate deletes an exception to make the core smaller
rows.expected_distinction: Size reduction cannot erase a material obligation. Give it a valid disposition and preserve its required behavior, or obtain the owning removal decision.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A domain rule is replaced by a shared-law reference
rows.expected_distinction: Preserve its material trigger, modal force, adoption conditions and exceptions. The shared owner and domain binding must supply the determination without circular referral.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A required generic rule is owned only by an optional profile
rows.expected_distinction: Generic use can obtain that determination without adopting the profile; profile-specific additions retain their selection boundary.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A functional helper is promoted into a new public mechanism
rows.expected_distinction: Require the material distinction or independent boundary that needs it. Shared machinery and subordinate helpers do not create new semantic or authority owners by naming alone.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A bounded object is declared a Markov object because its interface is small
rows.expected_distinction: An ordinary useful boundary supplies no proof of the stronger sufficiency or independence claim. State its assumptions and evidence; an unsupported claim stays unresolved.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: An a_c model omits a source condition but passes its schema check
rows.expected_distinction: The model fails fidelity for a decision affected by that condition. Mechanical validity cannot authorise the work that the owning source prohibits.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A faithful a_c fragment is offered as the whole method's interpretation
rows.expected_distinction: Account for every material owned determination and required dependency. The fragment establishes only its covered scope; missing material coverage prevents C3 closure for that tenant.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A frame uses an a_c projection rather than copying a clause verbatim
rows.expected_distinction: Assess fidelity and task sufficiency against the owning source. Different encoding alone is no defect; changed obligations or permissions are.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A compressed constraint surface treats an unresolved premise as unrestricted freedom
rows.expected_distinction: Preserve the unresolved dependency and apply the relevant stop, acquisition or refinement rule. Unknown permission is not a grant.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A task has several solutions inside the same constraint surface
rows.expected_distinction: Permit the alternatives that satisfy its contract. The method constrains admissibility without absorbing the worker's internal solution strategy.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A projection changes “not required” into “prohibited”, or preference into obligation
rows.expected_distinction: The changed permitted work is a fidelity defect unless an authorised successor relation establishes the change. Matching digests or valid schema do not repair it.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Ordinary entry points to an earlier formal interpretation marked current
rows.expected_distinction: Bind the current source, signature, program, maps and evidence boundary. Earlier models retain historical standing and cannot qualify the successor by selection error.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Information and its representation differ
rows.expected_distinction: Agreement in structure cannot establish identical meaning or semantic fidelity.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Identity is unchanged while content changes
rows.expected_distinction: The current state, and whether an earlier observation still applies, are considered separately.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Typed producers and consumers disagree
rows.expected_distinction: The incompatible domain or precondition is made explicit. Fields of the same shape do not make a valid join.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Assessment A failed and required coverage B is uncovered
rows.expected_distinction: A's authenticated failure and its citations survive, and B stays unresolved. Every planned assessment's returned judgement is authenticated against its producer, subject, basis and supporting evidence. B is required coverage outside those assessments, not an omitted planned judgement.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A genuinely planned assessment carries a judgement from a different subject
rows.expected_distinction: Plan membership does not authenticate the returned judgement. The misbound result cannot satisfy the assessment obligation.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: The context a task needs is interdependent and does not fit one actor
rows.expected_distinction: Narrowing the task lawfully, handing it to another capable actor, or a truthful stop keeps the material obligations.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A frame fits its byte limit but irrelevant material obscures a required dependency
rows.expected_distinction: Size alone does not establish adequacy. Keep the material dependency, exclude irrelevant material and evaluate actual use under the [frame requirement](../requirements/README.md#bounded-transitions-and-reference-frames).
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A frame or task changes after its trial, or actor instructions supply the expected answer
rows.expected_distinction: Bind the actual tested packet and independently specified expectations. Report the narrower evidence; a rewritten trial or matching source pin does not establish current task sufficiency.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: An author opens a fresh context to review its own candidate
rows.expected_distinction: A new context does not establish independent authorship or supply missing review authority. Ported contributions retain their authorship; the contributor's review cannot supply independent acceptance of them. Relevant common sources may still be shared by an independent reviewer.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A coordination frame omits frontier items from its current attention
rows.expected_distinction: Excluded work remains open; a bounded view cannot silently dispose it. The next decision retains its material dependencies.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A new observation exposes more obligations, or a destination is revised to make the current candidate pass
rows.expected_distinction: Discovery may increase the frontier while improving knowledge. Counts alone do not measure progress. A revised destination requires its owning decision and cannot establish that the original destination was reached.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: One directly authorised task fits a sufficient frame
rows.expected_distinction: The generic method permits the direct activation, subject to any separately required assessment. It imposes no fixed role inventory or actor sequence.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A peer configuration has no central Executive, or a task uses responsibilities outside the familiar three roles
rows.expected_distinction: Evaluate the configuration against the task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and required assurance. Different labels or topology neither reject nor accept it. The installed configuration selected to build this release retains its own scope.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Actors redistribute work during execution, including work with effects of uncertain completion
rows.expected_distinction: The permitted reconfiguration retains outstanding obligations and result dependencies, resolves material effect uncertainty before dependent action, and preserves authority and required independence. Self-organisation supplies no exemption from these conditions.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: An arrangement is called optimal because it is familiar, persistent or self-organised
rows.expected_distinction: Adequacy and optimality remain separate claims. An optimality claim needs stated objectives, constraints and comparison scope with supporting evidence. Different models or objectives can favour different configurations.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A coordinator receives a compact task result that omits a blocker material to delivery
rows.expected_distinction: Small size is insufficient. The coordinator retains the longer-term outcome and acquires the information needed for the next decision through its permitted frame inputs. Missing information cannot be assumed favourable.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A material dependency changes or a new observation invalidates an earlier claim
rows.expected_distinction: Affected applicability and validity are checked before reuse, including when the candidate's bytes are unchanged. Demonstrably independent supported work is kept.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A task packet contains relevant rules but lacks material context or authority
rows.expected_distinction: A rule packet alone is insufficient. The activated frame binds the contract, subject, evidence, capability and permitted effects required for the task.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A fresh actor has no private history, and a retained summary disagrees with the current workspace
rows.expected_distinction: Acquire the current subject and its authoritative inputs, correct the stale account, retain applicable work and continue within the grant. Discarding context does not erase the workspace or prove an uncertain external effect absent.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: An interruption leaves work partly written
rows.expected_distinction: Recovery uses the current workspace and the applicable work state. It does not erase progress or invent a completed assessment.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A parse or map succeeds
rows.expected_distinction: The claim stays mechanical until independently sufficient semantic and practical evidence exists.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A change to work carriers or process is proposed as new law
rows.expected_distinction: The claimed obligation is justified by its purpose and material relation, or identified as unsupported overhead.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: The same requirements are realised by software, a human team or a mixed process
rows.expected_distinction: Each tenant supplies its computational calculus, concrete execution binding and conformance evidence. Common requirements decide fitness; the kind of executor alone neither rejects nor accepts the realisation ([binding requirement](../requirements/README.md#build-tenant-binding-requirement)).
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A faster execution plan merges two required independent assessments or substitutes an automated result for a required human decision
rows.expected_distinction: Matching outputs or lower cost cannot discharge the lost independence or authority obligation. The binding fails conformance.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Two environments use one computational calculus, or one actor performs different kinds of operation
rows.expected_distinction: Each binding must satisfy the calculus's laws. Different stacks do not force duplicate calculi; actor identity does not determine operation kind or grant authority.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: An a_c model of a human process passes structural validation
rows.expected_distinction: The representation neither selects an automated executor nor establishes that the human process meets its requirements. Execution conformance needs its own applicable evidence.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Two loci in one candidate decide the same question
rows.expected_distinction: One is the [owning locus](../requirements/README.md#single-ownership-requirement). The other refers to it, or refines it with a mapping back to it. A frame's copy names its owner. No rule of precedence between loci substitutes for an owner.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A member or profile defines its own result values
rows.expected_distinction: Its owner maps each value, with its declared predicate and meaning-determining conditions, to exactly one core result. Failure, undecidability, non-performance and unknown effect completion never map to a higher standing. The predicate and domain outcome travel with the core value ([requirement](../requirements/README.md#single-result-algebra-requirement)).
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A lifecycle label or classification is used to decide admission, compliance or closure
rows.expected_distinction: Recorded data and the evaluation or authorised decision remain distinct. The actual determination uses the core result contract; calling it data cannot exempt it, and a core referral cannot replace a missing domain map.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A conserved heading now carries a different obligation, or a superseded row names only the old section
rows.expected_distinction: Compare the required and permitted decisions on the same material case, including modal force, triggers, scope and exceptions, under the [disposition requirement](../requirements/README.md#successor-disposition-requirement). An indicative rewrite is judged by its meaning, not its grammatical form. Each superseded claim identifies its replacement relation and owning loci; a proposed relation remains pending until accepted.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A frame's task returns a result
rows.expected_distinction: The frame carries the core result algebra or its profile's mapping into it.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A functor or categorical join is claimed
rows.expected_distinction: Before the claim, objects, arrows, arrow equality, identity and composition are given and the functor laws are shown. Otherwise the claim is a hypothesis ([standard](../requirements/README.md#categorical-demonstration-standard)).
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A rewrite or refinement step is applied
rows.expected_distinction: The law that permits it is declared for the subject. An exact step preserves meaning. An approximate step states its adequacy relation and an end-to-end bound.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Each member passes its local checks while two members still decide the same shared question differently
rows.expected_distinction: C3 closure requires the integrated reduction assessment. Separate satisfied member results cannot erase the cross-member contradiction.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: A member reviewer agrees that a proposed replacement is clear, but no owner decision accepts its changed meaning
rows.expected_distinction: Review may support the proposal; dependent member acceptance waits for the exact replacement decision recorded in the ticket. A construction grant does not supply that acceptance.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

rows.case: Five member criteria are satisfied and the sixth is missing, stale or falsified
rows.expected_distinction: The installed conjunction withholds member acceptance and preserves all component results. A general favourable verdict cannot replace missing or adverse evidence. Supported inapplicability of a conditional obligation is recorded separately; it does not waive any of the six criteria.
rows.limits: Authored route selection only. Mapping and resolved anchors do not establish the expected distinction; reviewer reads source and actual case.

donor_contribution.adaptation: Map current common cases to receiving owners and evidence outside product law. No donor acceptance or result semantics imported.

standing: authored coverage account; no passing results
